vetSays.line: ★ IDENTIFIED: Ground Elder. Creeping patches of divided leaves in shady spots. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Victor taught everyone about Ground Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Fireside lesson: Victor passes around Ground Elder. Someone asks a dumb question. Nobody minds. That's how you learn.
The fire burns low. 2 new lines in the journal tonight — loudest: Ground Elder — named and noted.
🛡️ Joshua, Asher, Earl and Sami met them at the door — 4 put down. Joshua, Asher, Earl, Sami are hurt.
🌿 Ground Elder — the foragers have handled it 8 days running. They know it now — which parts are worth hauling, which bruise, how it wants to be carried. The village's knowledge deepens.
💡 Ground Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/3) and it'll click.
🛡️ Joshua, Asher and Earl met them at the door — 3 put down. Joshua, Asher, Earl are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Joshua, Asher and Sami met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 barely walked away. Joshua, Asher, Sami are hurt.
🌿 Ground Elder, weeks in the baskets. Handling it day after day, the village has learned what it's FOR — not just what it is. The village knows its uses now.
💡 Ground Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/2) and it'll click.
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.
Gulden strikes the Scarred The Bright Bastard.
Gulden hits Scarred The Bright Bastard for 22.
Scarred The Bright Bastard's Antler Sweep hits you for 2.
Ethan strikes the Scarred The Bright Bastard.
Ethan hits Scarred The Bright Bastard for 60.
Gulden hits Scarred The Bright Bastard for 22.
Scarred The Bright Bastard's Antler Sweep hits you for 2.
Ethan hits Scarred The Bright Bastard for 20.
Scarred The Bright Bastard is BLEEDING — and it likes it. Louder, faster, no more feints.
It saw the opening coming — braced, scar tissue white. Your first strike glances off. (SCARRED: -3 first strike)
It should drop — but the light behind Scarred The Bright Bastard's eyes is already gathered. The body won't fall until it fires.
You STRIKE the Scarred The Bright Bastard for 117 (Machete).
Gulden hits Scarred The Bright Bastard for 22.
The Scarred The Bright Bastard falls.
You cut it down — but the light was already in its eyes. Scarred The Bright Bastard's death throes loose the beam.
Scarred The Bright Bastard's Ocular Discharge hits you for 32.
📺 Gulden brought down Scarred The Bright Bastard. Together. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Farid just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Joshua, Sami, Gulden, Farid and Onni met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Sami, Gulden, Farid are hurt.
🛡️ Joshua, Asher, Earl, Sami and Gulden met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Joshua, Asher, Earl, Gulden are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Onni just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Joshua, Sami, Gulden, Omar and Farid met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 barely walked away. Gulden didn't come back. Joshua, Sami, Omar, Farid are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ethan just put down Buffering... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Omar just put down Old Loud... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Earl just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Theo just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Theo met them at the door — 1 put down.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Jorge just put down The Big Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Jorge met them at the door — 1 put down. Jorge is hurt.
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
